messages.content: What happens to my card if I report it stolen?

response: When you report your card as stolen, the bank will immediately cancel the old card and issue a new one. The new card will have a different card number, expiration date, and CVV code for security purposes. You may also be asked to verify your identity before the card is replaced. It's important to contact your bank as soon as possible if you suspect that your card has been stolen to minimize potential fraudulent activity on your account.
